mapper.select: /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.dashboard.selectProjectStatusChart */ SELECT p.PJT_STATUS AS label, COUNT(p.PJT_ID) AS value FROM PJT p WHERE p.USER_ID = #{userId} GROUP BY p.PJT_STATUS ORDER BY p.PJT_STATUS

/* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.dashboard.selectTaskStatusChart */ SELECT s.STG_NAME AS label, COUNT(DISTINCT t.TASK_ID) AS value FROM TASK t INNER JOIN STG s ON t.STG_ID = s.STG_ID INNER JOIN PROJECT_USER_GROUP g ON t.PJT_ID = g.PJT_ID WHERE t.USER_ID = #{userId} GROUP BY s.STG_NAME ORDER BY s.STG_ID
